<a name="morpho-sdk.midnightsupplycollateral"></a>

## midnightSupplyCollateral() function

Encodes a direct Midnight collateral supply.

Use this low-level builder when a flow already knows the market, collateral index, and approval state. App flows should usually call `client.morpho.midnight(chainId).supplyCollateral(...)`<!-- -->, which resolves the ERC20 approval requirement before exposing `buildTx`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
midnightSupplyCollateral: (params: MidnightSupplyCollateralParams) => Readonly<Transaction<MidnightSupplyCollateralAction>>
```

## Parameters

A deep-frozen `Transaction<MidnightSupplyCollateralAction>` targeting `Midnight`<!-- -->.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `assets <= 0n`<!-- -->.

`ChainIdMismatchError` when the market targets another chain.

`MidnightMarketAddressMismatchError` when the market targets another Midnight deployment.

`UnknownCollateralIndexError` when `collateralIndex` is not configured on the market.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve `Midnight`<!-- -->.

- `params.market`<!-- -->: Midnight market receiving collateral.

- `params.collateralIndex`<!-- -->: Optional collateral index; defaults to `0n`<!-- -->.

- `params.assets`<!-- -->: Collateral assets to supply.

- `params.onBehalf`<!-- -->: Account whose collateral balance increases.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata appended to calldata.

## Example


```ts
import { midnightSupplyCollateral } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = midnightSupplyCollateral({
  chainId: 8453,
  market: marketData.params,
  collateralIndex: 0n,
  assets: 2_000_000n,
  onBehalf: user,
});
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.midnightsupplycollateraltakeborrow"></a>

## midnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrow() function

Encodes a Midnight bundle that supplies collateral and borrows in one call.

Prefer `client.morpho.midnight(chainId).supplyCollateralTakeBorrow(...)` in app flows so collateral approval and Midnight authorization requirements are resolved before building the bundle. Use this low-level builder only after market data and API takeable offers are already available.

**Signature:**

```typescript
midnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrow: (params: MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowParams) => Readonly<Transaction<MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowParams](#morpho-sdk.midnightsupplycollateraltakeborrowparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowAction](#morpho-sdk.midnightsupplycollateraltakeborrowaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowAction>` targeting `MidnightBundles`<!-- -->.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when collateral assets, loan assets, or `maxUnits` are non-positive.

`NegativeInputError` when `deadline` is negative.

`EmptyMidnightTakeableOffersError` when no offers are provided.

`MidnightOfferSideMismatchError` when any offer is not lend-side.

`MidnightTakeableOfferMarketMismatchError` when any offer belongs to another market.

`ChainIdMismatchError` when the market targets another chain.

`MidnightMarketAddressMismatchError` when the market targets another Midnight deployment.

`UnknownCollateralIndexError` when `collateralIndex` is not configured on the market.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve `MidnightBundles`<!-- -->.

- `params.market`<!-- -->: Midnight market traded by every takeable offer.

- `params.loanAssets`<!-- -->: Loan assets the borrower receives.

- `params.maxUnits`<!-- -->: Maximum debt units accepted from the bundle quote.

- `params.taker`<!-- -->: Borrower address executing the bundle.

- `params.deadline`<!-- -->: Bundle execution deadline timestamp; pass `maxUint256` explicitly for no expiry.

- `params.takeableOffers`<!-- -->: ABI-ready lend-side offers returned by the Midnight API.

- `params.collateralAssets`<!-- -->: Collateral assets supplied before taking offers.

- `params.collateralIndex`<!-- -->: Optional collateral index; defaults to `0n`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { maxUint256 } from "viem";
import { midnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrow } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = midnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrow({
  chainId: 8453,
  market: marketData.params,
  collateralAssets: 2_000_000n,
  loanAssets: 1_000_000n,
  maxUnits: 1_100_000n,
  taker: borrower,
  takeableOffers: quote.data.takeableOffers,
  deadline: maxUint256,
});
```

Encodes a Midnight bundle that borrows loan assets by taking lend-side offers.

Prefer `client.morpho.midnight(chainId).takeBorrow(...)` in app flows so authorization requirements are resolved first. Use this low-level builder only after the Midnight API has returned takeable offers and the caller has already handled prerequisites.

**Signature:**

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `loanAssets` or `maxUnits` is non-positive.

`NegativeInputError` when `deadline` is negative.

`EmptyMidnightTakeableOffersError` when no offers are provided.

`MidnightOfferSideMismatchError` when any offer is not lend-side.

`MidnightTakeableOfferMarketMismatchError` when any offer belongs to another market.

`ChainIdMismatchError` when the market targets another chain.

`MidnightMarketAddressMismatchError` when the market targets another Midnight deployment.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve `MidnightBundles`<!-- -->.

- `params.market`<!-- -->: Midnight market traded by every takeable offer.

- `params.loanAssets`<!-- -->: Loan assets the borrower receives.

- `params.maxUnits`<!-- -->: Maximum debt units accepted from the bundle quote.

- `params.taker`<!-- -->: Borrower address executing the bundle.

- `params.deadline`<!-- -->: Bundle execution deadline timestamp; pass `maxUint256` explicitly for no expiry.

- `params.takeableOffers`<!-- -->: ABI-ready lend-side offers returned by the Midnight API.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata appended to calldata.

## Example

```ts
import { maxUint256 } from "viem";

});
```

## midnightTakeLend() function

Encodes a Midnight bundle that lends loan assets by taking borrow-side offers.

Prefer `client.morpho.midnight(chainId).takeLend(...)` in app flows so approval and authorization requirements are resolved first. Use this low-level builder only after the Midnight API has returned takeable offers and the caller has already handled prerequisites.

**Signature:**

```typescript
midnightTakeLend: (params: MidnightTakeLendParams) => Readonly<Transaction<MidnightTakeLendAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[MidnightTakeLendParams](#morpho-sdk.midnighttakelendparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[MidnightTakeLendAction](#morpho-sdk.midnighttakelendaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<MidnightTakeLendAction>` targeting `MidnightBundles`<!-- -->.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `assets <= 0n`<!-- -->.

`NegativeInputError` when `minUnits` or `deadline` is negative.

`EmptyMidnightTakeableOffersError` when no offers are provided.

`MidnightOfferSideMismatchError` when any offer is not borrow-side.

`MidnightTakeableOfferMarketMismatchError` when any offer belongs to another market.

`ChainIdMismatchError` when the market targets another chain.

`MidnightMarketAddressMismatchError` when the market targets another Midnight deployment.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve `MidnightBundles`<!-- -->.

- `params.market`<!-- -->: Midnight market traded by every takeable offer.

- `params.assets`<!-- -->: Loan assets the lender spends.

- `params.minUnits`<!-- -->: Minimum units accepted from the bundle quote.

- `params.taker`<!-- -->: Lender address executing the bundle.

- `params.takeableOffers`<!-- -->: ABI-ready borrow-side offers returned by the Midnight API.

- `params.deadline`<!-- -->: Bundle execution deadline timestamp; pass `maxUint256` explicitly for no expiry.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata appended to calldata.

## Example


```ts
import { maxUint256 } from "viem";
import { midnightTakeLend } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = midnightTakeLend({
  chainId: 8453,
  market: marketData.params,
  assets: 1_000_000n,
  minUnits: 900_000n,
  taker: lender,
  takeableOffers: quote.data.takeableOffers,
  deadline: maxUint256,
});
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.morphoviemextension"></a>

## morphoViemExtension() function

Returns a viem `extend(...)` function that adds a stateless `morpho` namespace to a viem client. The namespace rides on top of the same client (one transport / chain / account) and exposes the protocol entity factories under `client.morpho`<!-- -->, so reads and writes share one client.

Holds no state beyond configuration: no cache, no `init()`<!-- -->, no warm-up. Each factory call (`client.morpho.vaultV1`<!-- -->, `vaultV2`<!-- -->, `blue`<!-- -->, `midnight`<!-- -->) returns a fresh entity bound to the client.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function morphoViemExtension(_options?: {
    readonly metadata?: Metadata;
    readonly supportSignature?: boolean;
    readonly supportDeployless?: boolean;
}): <TClient extends Client>(client: TClient) => {
    morpho: MorphoClientType;
};
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

\_options


</td><td>

{ readonly metadata?: [Metadata](#morpho-sdk.metadata)<!-- -->; readonly supportSignature?: boolean; readonly supportDeployless?: boolean; }


</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Optional SDK-wide options forwarded to the `morpho` namespace.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

&lt;TClient extends Client&gt;(client: TClient) =&gt; { morpho: [MorphoClientType](#morpho-sdk.morphoclienttype)<!-- -->; }

A viem extension function — `client.extend(morphoViemExtension(...))` adds `client.morpho`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `_options.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata applied to every transaction the `morpho` namespace builds.

- `_options.supportSignature`<!-- -->: Whether the integrator can collect EIP-712 signatures for permit / permit2. Defaults to `false` (classic approvals only).

- `_options.supportDeployless`<!-- -->: Whether entity fetchers may use deployless multicall.

## Example


```ts
import { createWalletClient, http, publicActions } from "viem";
import { mainnet } from "viem/chains";
import { morphoViemExtension } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const client = createWalletClient({
  chain: mainnet,
  transport: http(),
  account: user,
})
  .extend(publicActions)
  .extend(morphoViemExtension({ supportSignature: true }));

// Native viem reads and Morpho factories share the same client:
const block = await client.getBlockNumber();
const vault = client.morpho.vaultV1(vaultAddress, 1);
const vaultData = await vault.getData();
const { buildTx } = vault.deposit({
  amount: 1_000_000n,
  userAddress: user,
  vaultData,
});
const tx = buildTx();
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.previewvaultv2inkindredeem"></a>

## previewVaultV2InKindRedeem() function

Previews the single-market in-kind redemption choices needed by a Vault V2 frontend.

Vaults with exactly one MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 can produce choices. Their non-empty markets are returned in descending allocation order with the exact penalty-inclusive input ceiling, idle assets withdrawn directly, and resulting Blue position for `requestedExitAssets`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function previewVaultV2InKindRedeem(vaultData: AccrualVaultV2, params: PreviewVaultV2InKindRedeemParams): readonly VaultV2InKindRedeemMarketPreview[];
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

vaultData


</td><td>

[AccrualVaultV2](./blue-sdk.md#blue-sdk.accrualvaultv2)


</td><td>

Pre-fetched Vault V2 accrual snapshot.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[PreviewVaultV2InKindRedeemParams](#morpho-sdk.previewvaultv2inkindredeemparams)


</td><td>

Preview parameters.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

readonly [VaultV2InKindRedeemMarketPreview](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2inkindredeemmarketpreview)<!-- -->\[\]

Frontend-ready market choices, or an empty list when no choices are available.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.requestedExitAssets`<!-- -->: Positive penalty-inclusive amount the user wants to exit.

- `params.timestamp`<!-- -->: Timestamp used to accrue Morpho Blue markets before calculating capacity.

## Example


```ts
import { previewVaultV2InKindRedeem } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const [market] = previewVaultV2InKindRedeem(vaultData, {
  requestedExitAssets,
  timestamp: block.timestamp,
});
// market?.exitAssets is ready to pass to vault.inKindRedeem(...)
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.reallocationwithdrawexceedsmarketsupplyerror"></a>

## ReallocationWithdrawExceedsMarketSupplyError class

Thrown when a Vault V1 or Vault V2 reallocation planner receives a withdraw `amount` greater than the target market's current `totalSupplyAssets` — the post-withdraw supply would be negative, making the on-chain `morphoWithdraw` revert regardless of any reallocation. Caught here so callers do not pay PublicAllocator fees on an unreachable operation.

**Signature:**

<a name="morpho-sdk.repayactionamountargs"></a>

## RepayActionAmountArgs interface

Repay funding sources for the \*\*action layer\*\* (`blueRepay` / `blueRepayWithdrawCollateral`<!-- -->) — a flat, pre-resolved shape. The entity layer ([RepayAmountArgs](#morpho-sdk.repayamountargs)<!-- -->) derives these from live market state; the action does no amount arithmetic. The mode is discriminated on `shares`<!-- -->:

- \*\*assets mode\*\* (`shares` unset/`0n`<!-- -->): repays `transferAmount` assets (`= amount + nativeAmount`<!-- -->, additive like `blueSupply`<!-- -->), pulling `amount` ERC-20 and wrapping `nativeAmount`<!-- -->. No residual. - \*\*shares mode\*\* (`shares > 0n`<!-- -->): repays an exact borrow-share count (full close), pulling `transferAmount` ERC-20 (already net of native) and wrapping `nativeAmount`<!-- -->; the residual loan token is skimmed back to `receiver`<!-- -->.

`nativeAmount` requires the market's loan token to be the chain's wNative.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface RepayActionAmountArgs
```

</tbody></table>

<a name="morpho-sdk.repayamountargs"></a>

## RepayAmountArgs type

Repay funding sources for the \*\*entity layer\*\* (`MorphoBlue.repay` / `MorphoBlue.repayWithdrawCollateral`<!-- -->), which computes the loan-token `transferAmount` itself from live market state.

- \*\*assets mode\*\* ([DepositAmountArgs](#morpho-sdk.depositamountargs)<!-- -->): repay an exact asset total of `amount` (ERC-20) + `nativeAmount` (wrapped native). Additive — mirrors `blueSupply`<!-- -->. - \*\*shares mode\*\* (`{ shares }`<!-- -->): repay an exact borrow-share count (full close, immune to interest accrual). `nativeAmount` funds part of the transfer.

`nativeAmount` requires the market's loan token to be the chain's wNative.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RepayAmountArgs = DepositAmountArgs | {
    shares: bigint;
    nativeAmount?: bigint;
};
```
**References:** [DepositAmountArgs](#morpho-sdk.depositamountargs)

<a name="morpho-sdk.requirement"></a>

## Requirement interface

A signable approval / authorization requirement. `sign()` returns the matching [RequirementSignature](#morpho-sdk.requirementsignature)<!-- -->; `action` describes the requirement without signing.

Generic over the signature it produces so permit encoders narrow to [PermitRequirementSignature](#morpho-sdk.permitrequirementsignature) and the authorization encoder to [AuthorizationRequirementSignature](#morpho-sdk.authorizationrequirementsignature)<!-- -->; the two-parameter form is kept for Midnight action requirements that are parameterized by action and args.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Requirement<TSignatureOrAction extends RequirementSignature | SignatureRequirementAction = RequirementSignature, TArgs extends RequirementSignatureArgs | undefined = undefined>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.requirementsignature"></a>

## RequirementSignature type

The deep-frozen output of `Requirement.sign()`<!-- -->. Discriminated on `action.type`<!-- -->: `"permit"` / `"permit2"` carry Bundler3 token-approval args, `"authorization"` carries the signed Morpho authorization, and Midnight adds `"midnightOfferRootSignature"`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RequirementSignature<TAction extends SignatureRequirementAction | undefined = undefined, TArgs extends RequirementSignatureArgs | undefined = undefined> = TAction extends SignatureRequirementAction ? TArgs extends RequirementSignatureArgs ? {
    args: TArgs;
    action: TAction;
} : never : PermitRequirementSignature | AuthorizationRequirementSignature | MidnightOfferRootSignature;
```
**References:** [SignatureRequirementAction](#morpho-sdk.signaturerequirementaction)<!-- -->, [RequirementSignatureArgs](#morpho-sdk.requirementsignatureargs)<!-- -->, [PermitRequirementSignature](#morpho-sdk.permitrequirementsignature)<!-- -->, [AuthorizationRequirementSignature](#morpho-sdk.authorizationrequirementsignature)<!-- -->, [MidnightOfferRootSignature](#morpho-sdk.midnightofferrootsignature)

<a name="morpho-sdk.requirementsignatureargs"></a>

Argument payloads returned by signature requirements.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RequirementSignatureArgs = PermitArgs | Permit2Args | AuthorizationSignatureArgs | MidnightOfferRootSignatureArgs;
```
**References:** [PermitArgs](#morpho-sdk.permitargs)<!-- -->, [Permit2Args](#morpho-sdk.permit2args)<!-- -->, [AuthorizationSignatureArgs](#morpho-sdk.authorizationsignatureargs)<!-- -->, [MidnightOfferRootSignatureArgs](#morpho-sdk.midnightofferrootsignatureargs)

<a name="morpho-sdk.selectrequirementsignatures"></a>

## selectRequirementSignatures() function

Splits a `buildTx` signature array into its typed requirement-signature slots, rejecting ambiguous or unexpected input so a path never silently consumes the wrong signature.

A bundled path consumes at most one signature of each accepted kind. Passing several of the same kind, or a kind the path does not consume, is rejected with a typed error rather than silently dropping the extras — the latter could otherwise leave a required authorization or permit unsigned (and the bundle reverting on-chain) or apply the wrong signature.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function selectRequirementSignatures(signatures: readonly RequirementSignature[] | undefined, accepts: {
    permit?: boolean;
    authorization?: boolean;
    midnightOfferRoot?: boolean;
}): SelectedRequirementSignatures;
```

signatures


</td><td>

</td><td>

The signatures passed to `buildTx`<!-- -->.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

accepts


</td><td>

{ permit?: boolean; authorization?: boolean; midnightOfferRoot?: boolean; }


</td><td>

Which signature kinds this operation consumes.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

[SelectedRequirementSignatures](#morpho-sdk.selectedrequirementsignatures)

The single permit and/or authorization signature, when present.

## Exceptions

`AmbiguousRequirementSignaturesError` when more than one signature of an accepted kind is present.

`UnexpectedRequirementSignatureError` when a signature of a kind the operation does not consume is present.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `accepts.permit`<!-- -->: Whether a permit / Permit2 signature is consumed.

- `accepts.authorization`<!-- -->: Whether a Morpho authorization signature is consumed.

- `accepts.midnightOfferRoot`<!-- -->: Whether a Midnight offer-root signature is consumed.

## Example


```ts
import { selectRequirementSignatures } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const { permit, authorization } = selectRequirementSignatures(signatures, {
  permit: true,
  authorization: true,
});
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.setterratifierratifyroot"></a>

## setterRatifierRatifyRoot() function

Encodes a SetterRatifier root-ratification transaction.

Use this after building a Setter-ratified offer tree and before submitting its mempool payload. Entity make-offer flows expose the same transaction through `getRequirements()` when the root is not already approved.

**Signature:**

```typescript
setterRatifierRatifyRoot: (params: SetterRatifierRatifyRootParams) => Readonly<Transaction<SetterRatifierRatifyRootAction>>
```

params

</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[SetterRatifierRatifyRootAction](#morpho-sdk.setterratifierratifyrootaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<SetterRatifierRatifyRootAction>` targeting `SetterRatifier`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve `SetterRatifier`<!-- -->.

- `params.maker`<!-- -->: Maker whose root approval is updated.

- `params.root`<!-- -->: Offer-tree root to approve or revoke.

- `params.isRootRatified`<!-- -->: Optional target state; defaults to `true`<!-- -->.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata appended to calldata.

```ts
import { setterRatifierRatifyRoot } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = setterRatifierRatifyRoot({
  chainId: 8453,
  maker,
  root,
});
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.signandverifytypeddata"></a>

## signAndVerifyTypedData() function

Signs EIP-712 typed data with a wallet client, verifies that the produced signature recovers `userAddress`<!-- -->, and returns the signature.

Use inside requirement `sign(...)` callbacks before converting a signature into protocol calldata or mempool payload bytes. The verification step keeps wallet/account mismatches from reaching transaction builders.

**Signature:**

```typescript
signAndVerifyTypedData: (params: {
    readonly client: WalletClient;
    readonly userAddress: Address;
    readonly typedData: TypedDataDefinition<Record<string, unknown>, string>;
}) => Promise<Hex>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

{ readonly client: WalletClient; readonly userAddress: Address; readonly typedData: TypedDataDefinition&lt;Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;, string&gt;; }


</td><td>

Signing and verification parameters.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;Hex&gt;

The verified EIP-712 signature.

## Exceptions

`MissingClientPropertyError` when the wallet client has no account address.

`AddressMismatchError` when the wallet client account differs from `userAddress`<!-- -->.

`ChainIdMismatchError` when the wallet client targets a different chain than the typed-data domain.

`InvalidSignatureError` when the signature does not recover to `userAddress`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.client`<!-- -->: Wallet client used to sign the typed data.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: Address expected to own the produced signature.

- `params.typedData`<!-- -->: EIP-712 typed data to sign and verify.

## Example


```ts
import { signAndVerifyTypedData } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const signature = await signAndVerifyTypedData({
  client: walletClient,
  userAddress: maker,
  typedData: offerRootTypedData,
});
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.validateaccrualposition"></a>

## validateAccrualPosition() function

Validates that the accrual position belongs to the expected market and user. Throws [MarketIdMismatchError](#morpho-sdk.marketidmismatcherror) if the position's market ID does not match the expected market. Throws [AccrualPositionUserMismatchError](#morpho-sdk.accrualpositionusermismatcherror) if the position's user does not match the expected user.

**Signature:**

```typescript

    positionData: AccrualPosition;
    expectedMarketId: MarketId;
    expectedUser: Address;
}) => void
```

Validates that Midnight offers match a named flow's maker side.

Use before encoding a side-specific Midnight action: make-lend and take-borrow consume buy offers (`expectedBuy: true`<!-- -->), while make-borrow and take-lend consume sell offers (`expectedBuy: false`<!-- -->).

```typescript
    readonly buy: boolean;
}>, expectedBuy: boolean) => void
```

Offers to validate.

expectedBuy


</td><td>

boolean

## validateReallocations() function

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.

> Vault V1 PublicAllocator validation will be removed in the next major. Use Vault V2 reallocations for new integrations.
>

Validates that Vault V1 PublicAllocator reallocations are well-formed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validateReallocations: (reallocations: Iterable<VaultV1Reallocation>, targetMarketId: MarketId) => void
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

reallocations


</td><td>

Iterable&lt;[VaultV1Reallocation](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1reallocation)<!-- -->&gt;


</td><td>

Vault V1 reallocations to validate.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

targetMarketId


</td><td>

[MarketId](./blue-sdk.md#blue-sdk.marketid)


</td><td>

The operation's target market ID.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

void

Nothing when every reallocation is valid.

## Exceptions

`NegativeInputError` when a reallocation fee is negative.

`EmptyReallocationWithdrawalsError` when a reallocation has no withdrawals.

`NonPositiveInputError` when a withdrawal amount is non-positive.

`ReallocationWithdrawalOnTargetMarketError` when a withdrawal references the target market.

`UnsortedReallocationWithdrawalsError` when withdrawals are not strictly market-id sorted.

## Example


```ts
import type { BlueMarketId } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk/types";
import { validateReallocations } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";
import { zeroHash } from "viem";

const result: void = validateReallocations([], zeroHash as BlueMarketId);
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.validateuseraddress"></a>

## validateUserAddress() function

Asserts that the client has a connected account AND that it matches the provided user address.

Used internally by the signature requirements (`encodeErc20Permit`<!-- -->, `encodeErc20Permit2Approve`<!-- -->) to enforce builder = signer at `sign()` time: the signing flow is the only path where an account/address mismatch is a real security concern (rather than just an integrator footgun).

Transaction builders no longer call this helper — callers are responsible for keeping `userAddress` aligned with the signing account at the builder layer.

Throws [MissingClientPropertyError](#morpho-sdk.missingclientpropertyerror) if the client has no account. Throws [AddressMismatchError](#morpho-sdk.addressmismatcherror) if the client account differs from `userAddress`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function validateUserAddress(clientAccountAddress: Address | undefined, userAddress: Address): asserts clientAccountAddress is Address;
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

clientAccountAddress


</td><td>

Address \| undefined


</td><td>

The client's account address; if undefined, `MissingClientPropertyError` is thrown.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

userAddress


</td><td>

Address


</td><td>

The user address provided by the caller.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

asserts clientAccountAddress is Address

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1actions.deposit"></a>

## VaultV1Actions.deposit property

Prepares a deposit into a VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) contract.

Uses pre-fetched vault data to compute `maxSharePrice` with slippage tolerance, then returns `buildTx` and `getRequirements` for lazy evaluation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
deposit: (params: {
        userAddress: Address;
        vaultData: AccrualVault;
        slippageTolerance?: bigint;
    } & DepositAmountArgs) => {
        buildTx: (signatures?: readonly RequirementSignature[]) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1DepositAction>>;
        getRequirements: (params?: {
            useSimplePermit?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<(Readonly<Transaction<ERC20ApprovalAction>> | Requirement<PermitRequirementSignature>)[]>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.amount`<!-- -->: Amount of assets to deposit.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: User address initiating the deposit.

- `params.vaultData`<!-- -->: Pre-fetched vault data with asset address and share conversion.

- `params.slippageTolerance`<!-- -->: Optional. Default: `DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_TOLERANCE`<!-- -->. Slippage tolerance (default 0.03%, max 10%).

- `params.nativeAmount`<!-- -->: Optional. Amount of native ETH to wrap into WETH. Vault asset must be wNative.

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1actions.inkindredeem"></a>

## VaultV1Actions.inKindRedeem property

Prepares an illiquid Vault V1 exit into the vault's Morpho Blue supply positions.

The caller controls market order and must call `getRequirements()` before `buildTx()` so the RPC-backed Blue-balance and Morpho-deployment checks run. The SDK validates market coverage but intentionally does not validate the user's share balance; size `amount` in asset terms against `previewRedeem(sharesHeld)`<!-- -->. The share allowance first accrues pending performance-fee shares, then uses the current rounded-up share preview; future interest can only reduce the required burn.

Snapshot state can drift before inclusion, so a later reallocation may still make the on-chain loop under-cover even after pre-flight succeeds.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly inKindRedeem: (params: {
        readonly amount: bigint;
        readonly marketParamsList: readonly MarketParams[];
        readonly vaultData: AccrualVault;
        readonly userAddress: Address;
        readonly deadline?: bigint;
    }) => ActionOutput<VaultV1InKindRedeemAction, readonly RequirementSignature[], undefined>;
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.amount`<!-- -->: Asset-denominated amount to exit.

- `params.marketParamsList`<!-- -->: Ordered vault markets consumed greedily by the contract; repeated entries cannot draw from the same vault position twice.

- `params.vaultData`<!-- -->: Pre-fetched Vault V1 accrual snapshot.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: Account that signs and submits the exit.

- `params.deadline`<!-- -->: Optional shared permit/bundle deadline; defaults to two hours from now.

## Example


```ts
import { isRequirementSignature } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const vault = client.morpho.vaultV1(vaultAddress, 1);
const vaultData = await vault.getData();
const exit = vault.inKindRedeem({
  amount: 1_000_000n,
  marketParamsList,
  vaultData,
  userAddress,
});
const signatures = [];
for (const requirement of await exit.getRequirements()) {
  if (isRequirementSignature(requirement)) {
    signatures.push(await requirement.sign(walletClient, userAddress));
  } else {
    const hash = await walletClient.sendTransaction(requirement);
    await client.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
  }
}
const tx = exit.buildTx(signatures);
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1InKindRedeemAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1actions.migratetov2"></a>

## VaultV1Actions.migrateToV2 property

Prepares a full migration from VaultV1 to VaultV2.

Redeems all V1 shares and atomically deposits the resulting assets into V2 via bundler3. Computes slippage-protected share prices for both legs.

**Signature:**

```typescript
migrateToV2: (params: {
        userAddress: Address;
        sourceVault: AccrualVault;
        targetVault: AccrualVaultV2;
        shares: bigint;
        slippageTolerance?: bigint;
    }) => {
        buildTx: (signatures?: readonly RequirementSignature[]) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1MigrateToV2Action>>;
        getRequirements: () => Promise<(Readonly<Transaction<ERC20ApprovalAction>> | Requirement<PermitRequirementSignature>)[]>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: User address initiating the migration.

- `params.sourceVault`<!-- -->: Pre-fetched V1 vault data.

- `params.targetVault`<!-- -->: Pre-fetched V2 vault data.

- `params.shares`<!-- -->: User's V1 share balance to migrate.

- `params.slippageTolerance`<!-- -->: Optional. Default: `DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_TOLERANCE`<!-- -->. Slippage tolerance (default 0.03%, max 10%).

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1deposit"></a>

## vaultV1Deposit() function

Prepares a deposit transaction for a VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) contract.

Routed through bundler3 to atomically execute the asset transfer and vault deposit. The `GeneralAdapter1` enforces `maxSharePrice` on-chain to prevent inflation attacks. Never bypass the general adapter.

When `nativeAmount > 0`<!-- -->, that amount of native ETH is sent as `msg.value` to the bundler3 multicall and wrapped into wNative via `GeneralAdapter1.wrapNative()`<!-- -->. The vault's underlying asset must be the chain's wrapped native token.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV1Deposit: (params: VaultV1DepositParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1DepositAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV1DepositParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1depositparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV1DepositAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1depositaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV1DepositAction>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`NegativeInputError` when `amount < 0n` or `nativeAmount < 0n`<!-- -->.

`NonPositiveInputError` when `maxSharePrice <= 0n`<!-- -->, or when both `amount` and `nativeAmount` resolve to zero.

`ChainWNativeMissingError` when `nativeAmount` is provided but the chain has no configured wNative.

`NativeAmountOnNonWNativeVaultError` when `nativeAmount` is provided but the vault asset is not the chain's wNative.

`DepositAssetMismatchError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `amount > 0n` and `requirementSignature` is provided and the signed asset differs from `vault.asset`<!-- -->. The signature is ignored on the native-only path (`amount === 0n` with `nativeAmount > 0n`<!-- -->).

`DepositAmountMismatchError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `amount > 0n` and `requirementSignature` is provided and the signed amount differs from `args.amount`<!-- -->.

`Permit2ExpirationMissingError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `amount > 0n` and a Permit2 requirement signature is missing its expiration.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.chainId`<!-- -->: The chain the vault lives on.

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) address.

- `params.vault.asset`<!-- -->: The vault's underlying ERC-20 asset.

- `params.args.amount`<!-- -->: Amount of ERC-20 assets to deposit. At least one of `amount` or `nativeAmount` must be positive. Defaults to `0n`<!-- -->.

- `params.args.maxSharePrice`<!-- -->: Maximum acceptable share price (in RAY, slippage protection enforced on-chain by `GeneralAdapter1`<!-- -->).

- `params.args.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the minted vault shares.

- `params.args.requirementSignature`<!-- -->: Optional pre-signed permit/permit2 approval.

- `params.args.nativeAmount`<!-- -->: Optional amount of native token to wrap into wNative for the deposit. Requires the vault asset to be the chain's wNative.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the bundle.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV1Deposit } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV1Deposit({
  vault: { chainId: 1, address: vaultAddress, asset: USDC },
  args: {
    amount: 1_000_000n,
    maxSharePrice: 1_010_000_000_000_000_000_000_000_000n, // RAY-scaled, 1.01x
    recipient: depositor,
  },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1DepositAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1inkindredeem"></a>

## vaultV1InKindRedeem() function

Prepares a Vault V1 in-kind redemption into Morpho Blue supply positions.

The transaction calls VaultExitBundlesV1 directly. Without a signature it embeds the contract's empty-permit sentinel; the user must first approve enough shares for the exit.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV1InKindRedeem: (params: VaultV1InKindRedeemParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1InKindRedeemAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV1InKindRedeemParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1inkindredeemparams)


</td><td>

In-kind redemption parameters.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV1InKindRedeemAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1inkindredeemaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1InKindRedeemAction>>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed action discriminator.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `amount` or `deadline` is not positive.

`EmptyMarketParamsListError` when no markets are supplied.

`UnsupportedChainIdError` when no address registry exists for the target chain.

`UnknownAddressError` when VaultExitBundlesV1 is not registered on the target chain.

`VaultExitBundlesV1PermitMismatchError` when the requirement has the wrong permit kind, asset, or signature encoding.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain containing the target Vault V1 and VaultExitBundlesV1.

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: Target Vault V1 address.

- `params.args.amount`<!-- -->: Asset-denominated amount to exit.

- `params.args.marketParamsList`<!-- -->: Ordered markets consumed greedily by the contract.

- `params.args.userAddress`<!-- -->: Expected transaction sender, recorded in action metadata only. VaultExitBundlesV1 burns `msg.sender`<!-- -->'s vault shares, so the submitting account must equal this address.

- `params.args.deadline`<!-- -->: Permit and bundle deadline.

- `params.args.requirementSignature`<!-- -->: Optional bounded Vault V1 shares permit.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV1InKindRedeem } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV1InKindRedeem({
  vault: { chainId: 1, address: vault },
  args: { amount: 1_000_000n, marketParamsList, userAddress, deadline },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1InKindRedeemAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1migratetov2"></a>

## vaultV1MigrateToV2() function

Prepares an atomic full-migration transaction from VaultV1 to VaultV2.

Routed through bundler3: transfers V1 shares to `GeneralAdapter1` (via `erc20TransferFrom` or permit/permit2), redeems them via `erc4626Redeem` (GA1 redeems its own shares — no allowance check), then deposits the resulting assets into V2 via `erc4626Deposit`<!-- -->. All operations execute atomically in a single transaction.

Prerequisite: the user must either approve `GeneralAdapter1` to spend their V1 vault shares (classic approve) or provide a pre-signed permit/permit2 via `requirementSignature`<!-- -->. Use `getRequirements()` on the entity to resolve the appropriate approval.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV1MigrateToV2: (params: VaultV1MigrateToV2Params) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1MigrateToV2Action>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV1MigrateToV2Params](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1migratetov2params)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV1MigrateToV2Action](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1migratetov2action)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV1MigrateToV2Action>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`VaultAssetMismatchError` when `targetAsset` differs from `vault.asset`<!-- -->.

`NonPositiveInputError` when `shares <= 0n` or `maxSharePriceVaultV2 <= 0n`<!-- -->.

`NegativeInputError` when `minSharePriceVaultV1 < 0n`<!-- -->.

`DepositAssetMismatchError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `requirementSignature` is provided and the signed asset differs from `vault.address` (the V1 share token).

`DepositAmountMismatchError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `requirementSignature` is provided and the signed amount differs from `args.shares`<!-- -->.

`Permit2ExpirationMissingError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when a Permit2 requirement signature is missing its expiration.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.chainId`<!-- -->: The chain the source vault lives on (used to resolve bundler addresses).

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The source VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) address.

- `params.vault.asset`<!-- -->: The underlying asset of the source V1 vault.

- `params.args.targetVault`<!-- -->: The target VaultV2 address.

- `params.args.targetAsset`<!-- -->: The underlying asset of the target V2 vault. Must equal `vault.asset`<!-- -->.

- `params.args.shares`<!-- -->: Number of V1 shares to migrate.

- `params.args.minSharePriceVaultV1`<!-- -->: Minimum V1 share price in RAY (slippage protection for the redeem leg).

- `params.args.maxSharePriceVaultV2`<!-- -->: Maximum V2 share price in RAY (inflation protection for the deposit leg).

- `params.args.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the V2 vault shares.

- `params.args.requirementSignature`<!-- -->: Optional pre-signed permit/permit2 for the V1 share transfer.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the bundle.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV1MigrateToV2 } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV1MigrateToV2({
  vault: { chainId: 1, address: sourceVault, asset: USDC },
  args: {
    targetVault,
    targetAsset: USDC,
    shares: 1_000_000n,
    minSharePriceVaultV1: 0n, // disables redeem-leg slippage protection — production code should compute from source vault state + slippage tolerance
    maxSharePriceVaultV2: 1_010_000_000_000_000_000_000_000_000n, // RAY-scaled, 1.01x
    recipient,
  },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1MigrateToV2Action>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv1withdraw"></a>

## vaultV1Withdraw() function

Prepares a withdraw transaction for a VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) contract.

Direct vault call — no bundler needed. Withdraw has no inflation-attack surface.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV1Withdraw: (params: VaultV1WithdrawParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1WithdrawAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV1WithdrawParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1withdrawparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV1WithdrawAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv1withdrawaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV1WithdrawAction>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `amount <= 0n`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The VaultV1 (MetaMorpho) address.

- `params.args.amount`<!-- -->: Amount of underlying assets to withdraw.

- `params.args.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the withdrawn assets.

- `params.args.onBehalf`<!-- -->: Address whose shares are burned.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the transaction.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV1Withdraw } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV1Withdraw({
  vault: { address: vaultAddress },
  args: { amount: 500_000n, recipient, onBehalf },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV1WithdrawAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2actions.deposit"></a>

## VaultV2Actions.deposit property

Prepares a deposit transaction for the VaultV2 contract.

This function constructs the transaction data required to deposit a specified amount of assets into the vault. Uses pre-fetched vault data for accurate calculations of slippage and asset address, then returns the prepared deposit transaction and a function for retrieving all required approval transactions. Bundler Integration: This flow uses the bundler to atomically execute the user's asset transfer and vault deposit in a single transaction for slippage protection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
deposit: (params: {
        userAddress: Address;
        vaultData: AccrualVaultV2;
        slippageTolerance?: bigint;
    } & DepositAmountArgs) => {
        buildTx: (signatures?: readonly RequirementSignature[]) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2DepositAction>>;
        getRequirements: (params?: {
            useSimplePermit?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<(Readonly<Transaction<ERC20ApprovalAction>> | Requirement<PermitRequirementSignature>)[]>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.amount`<!-- -->: Optional. Default: `0n`<!-- -->. Amount of ERC-20 assets to deposit. At least one of amount or nativeAmount must be provided.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: User address initiating the deposit.

- `params.vaultData`<!-- -->: Pre-fetched vault data with asset address and share conversion.

- `params.slippageTolerance`<!-- -->: Optional. Default: `DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_TOLERANCE`<!-- -->. Optional slippage tolerance value. Default is 0.03%. Slippage tolerance must be less than 10%.

- `params.nativeAmount`<!-- -->: Optional. Amount of native token to wrap into wNative. Vault asset must be wNative.

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2actions.forceredeem"></a>

## VaultV2Actions.forceRedeem property

Prepares a force redeem transaction for the VaultV2 contract using the vault's native multicall.

This function encodes one or more on-chain forceDeallocate calls followed by a single redeem, executed atomically via VaultV2's multicall. This allows a user to free liquidity from multiple illiquid markets and redeem all their shares in one transaction.

This is the share-based counterpart to forceWithdraw, useful for maximum withdrawal scenarios where specifying an exact asset amount is impractical.

The total assets passed to forceDeallocate calls must be greater than or equal to the asset-equivalent of the redeemed shares. The caller should apply a buffer on the deallocated amounts to account for share-price drift between submission and execution.

**Signature:**

```typescript
forceRedeem: (params: {
        deallocations: readonly Deallocation[];
        redeem: {
            shares: bigint;
        };
        userAddress: Address;
    }) => {
        buildTx: () => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2ForceRedeemAction>>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.deallocations`<!-- -->: The typed list of deallocations to perform.

- `params.redeem`<!-- -->: The redeem parameters applied after deallocations.

- `params.redeem.shares`<!-- -->: The amount of shares to redeem.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: User address (penalty source and redeem recipient).

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2actions.inkindredeem"></a>

## VaultV2Actions.inKindRedeem property

Prepares an illiquid Vault V2 exit into idle assets and Morpho Blue supply positions.

The vault must have exactly one `MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2`<!-- -->. `amount` is penalty-inclusive and the caller controls market order. Call `getRequirements()` before `buildTx()` so Blue balance, allowance, and nonce are checked on-chain. Vault gates are enforced by the final transaction and are not preflighted: receive gates may depend on VaultExitBundlesV1's transient initiator, while arbitrary send-share gates may depend on intermediate state changed by the exit's multiple share burns. The SDK intentionally does not validate the user's share balance; size it so `amount + BigInt(marketParamsList.length) <= vault.previewRedeem(sharesHeld)`<!-- -->. The per-market term covers V2 withdrawal rounding and is not needed for V1. The share allowance includes that buffer, the penalty burns, and accrual through the bundle deadline.

Idle balance, penalty, and adapter positions can drift after the snapshot, so an on-chain under-coverage panic remains possible if vault state changes between preparation and inclusion.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly inKindRedeem: (params: {
        readonly amount: bigint;
        readonly marketParamsList: readonly MarketParams[];
        readonly vaultData: AccrualVaultV2;
        readonly userAddress: Address;
        readonly adapter?: Address;
        readonly deadline?: bigint;
    }) => ActionOutput<VaultV2InKindRedeemAction, readonly RequirementSignature[], undefined>;
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.amount`<!-- -->: Penalty-inclusive, asset-denominated amount to exit.

- `params.marketParamsList`<!-- -->: Ordered adapter markets consumed greedily after idle assets; its length is also the V2 share-sufficiency rounding buffer.

- `params.vaultData`<!-- -->: Pre-fetched Vault V2 accrual snapshot.

- `params.userAddress`<!-- -->: Account that signs and submits the exit.

- `params.adapter`<!-- -->: Optional adapter override; defaults to the vault's sole adapter.

- `params.deadline`<!-- -->: Optional shared permit/bundle deadline; defaults to two hours from now.

## Example


```ts
import { isRequirementSignature } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const vault = client.morpho.vaultV2(vaultAddress, 1);
const vaultData = await vault.getData();
const exit = vault.inKindRedeem({
  amount: 1_000_000n,
  marketParamsList,
  vaultData,
  userAddress,
});
const signatures = [];
for (const requirement of await exit.getRequirements()) {
  if (isRequirementSignature(requirement)) {
    signatures.push(await requirement.sign(walletClient, userAddress));
  } else {
    const hash = await walletClient.sendTransaction(requirement);
    await client.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
  }
}
const tx = exit.buildTx(signatures);
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2InKindRedeemAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2bluepublicallocatoroptions.maxpenalty"></a>

## VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorOptions.maxPenalty property

Maximum proportional vault-asset penalty accepted for each BluePublicAllocator call, scaled by WAD. Vaults with a higher configured penalty are ignored. Must not exceed WAD (100%).

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly maxPenalty?: bigint;
```

## Default Value

0n

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2bluepublicallocatoroptions.maxwithdrawalutilization"></a>

## VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorOptions.maxWithdrawalUtilization property

Maximum utilization source markets may reach during friendly discovery, scaled by WAD. The amount-aware planner falls back to 100% only when the friendly phase cannot cover the operation's absolute shortfall.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly maxWithdrawalUtilization?: bigint;
```

## Default Value

90% (900000000000000000n)

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2deposit"></a>

## vaultV2Deposit() function

Prepares a deposit transaction for a VaultV2 contract.

Routed through bundler3 to atomically execute the asset transfer and vault deposit. The `GeneralAdapter1` enforces `maxSharePrice` on-chain to prevent inflation attacks. Never bypass the general adapter.

When `nativeAmount > 0`<!-- -->, that amount of native ETH is sent as `msg.value` to the bundler3 multicall and wrapped into wNative via `GeneralAdapter1.wrapNative()`<!-- -->. The vault's underlying asset must be the chain's wrapped native token.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV2Deposit: (params: VaultV2DepositParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2DepositAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV2DepositParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2depositparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV2DepositAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2depositaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV2DepositAction>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`NegativeInputError` when `amount < 0n` or `nativeAmount < 0n`<!-- -->.

`NonPositiveInputError` when `maxSharePrice <= 0n`<!-- -->, or when both `amount` and `nativeAmount` resolve to zero.

`ChainWNativeMissingError` when `nativeAmount` is provided but the chain has no configured wNative.

`NativeAmountOnNonWNativeVaultError` when `nativeAmount` is provided but the vault asset is not the chain's wNative.

`DepositAssetMismatchError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `amount > 0n` and `requirementSignature` is provided and the signed asset differs from `vault.asset`<!-- -->. The signature is ignored on the native-only path (`amount === 0n` with `nativeAmount > 0n`<!-- -->).

`DepositAmountMismatchError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `amount > 0n` and `requirementSignature` is provided and the signed amount differs from `args.amount`<!-- -->.

`Permit2ExpirationMissingError` from `getTokenRequirementActions` when `amount > 0n` and a Permit2 requirement signature is missing its expiration.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.chainId`<!-- -->: The chain the vault lives on.

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The VaultV2 address.

- `params.vault.asset`<!-- -->: The vault's underlying ERC-20 asset.

- `params.args.amount`<!-- -->: Amount of ERC-20 assets to deposit. At least one of `amount` or `nativeAmount` must be positive. Defaults to `0n`<!-- -->.

- `params.args.maxSharePrice`<!-- -->: Maximum acceptable share price (in RAY, slippage protection enforced on-chain by `GeneralAdapter1`<!-- -->).

- `params.args.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the minted vault shares.

- `params.args.requirementSignature`<!-- -->: Optional pre-signed permit/permit2 approval.

- `params.args.nativeAmount`<!-- -->: Optional amount of native token to wrap into wNative for the deposit. Requires the vault asset to be the chain's wNative.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the bundle.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV2Deposit } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV2Deposit({
  vault: { chainId: 1, address: vaultAddress, asset: USDC },
  args: {
    amount: 1_000_000n,
    maxSharePrice: 1_010_000_000_000_000_000_000_000_000n, // RAY-scaled, 1.01x
    recipient: depositor,
  },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2DepositAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2forceredeem"></a>

## vaultV2ForceRedeem() function

Prepares a force-redeem transaction for a VaultV2 contract via the vault's native `multicall`<!-- -->.

Encodes one or more `forceDeallocate` calls followed by a single `redeem`<!-- -->, executed atomically through VaultV2's `multicall`<!-- -->. Share-based counterpart to [vaultV2ForceWithdraw()](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2forcewithdraw) — use when the user wants to redeem an exact share amount rather than withdraw exact assets.

The total assets passed to `forceDeallocate` calls must be greater than or equal to the asset-equivalent of the redeemed shares. The caller should apply a buffer on the deallocated amounts to absorb share-price drift between submission and execution.

A penalty is taken from `onBehalf` for each deallocation to discourage allocation manipulation. The penalty is applied as a share burn where assets are returned to the vault, so the share price stays stable (except for rounding).

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV2ForceRedeem: (params: VaultV2ForceRedeemParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2ForceRedeemAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV2ForceRedeemParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2forceredeemparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV2ForceRedeemAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2forceredeemaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV2ForceRedeemAction>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`EmptyDeallocationsError` when `deallocations` is empty.

`NonPositiveInputError` when `redeem.shares <= 0n` or any deallocation amount is non-positive.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The VaultV2 address.

- `params.args.deallocations`<!-- -->: The deallocations to perform before redeeming. Must be non-empty.

- `params.args.redeem.shares`<!-- -->: Amount of vault shares to redeem after the deallocations complete.

- `params.args.redeem.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the redeemed assets.

- `params.args.onBehalf`<!-- -->: Address whose shares are burned and from which the deallocation penalty is taken.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the multicall transaction.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV2ForceRedeem } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV2ForceRedeem({
  vault: { address: vaultAddress },
  args: {
    deallocations: [{ adapter, marketParams, amount: 1_010_000n }],
    redeem: { shares: 1_000_000n, recipient },
    onBehalf,
  },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2ForceRedeemAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2forcewithdraw"></a>

## vaultV2ForceWithdraw() function

Prepares a force-withdraw transaction for a VaultV2 contract via the vault's native `multicall`<!-- -->.

Encodes one or more `forceDeallocate` calls followed by a single `withdraw`<!-- -->, executed atomically through VaultV2's `multicall`<!-- -->. Frees liquidity from non-liquidity adapters and withdraws the resulting assets in one transaction.

A penalty is taken from `onBehalf` for each deallocation to discourage allocation manipulation. The penalty is applied as a share burn where assets are returned to the vault, so the share price stays stable (except for rounding).

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV2ForceWithdraw: (params: VaultV2ForceWithdrawParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2ForceWithdrawAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV2ForceWithdrawParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2forcewithdrawparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV2ForceWithdrawAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2forcewithdrawaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV2ForceWithdrawAction>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`EmptyDeallocationsError` when `deallocations` is empty.

`NonPositiveInputError` when `withdraw.amount <= 0n`<!-- -->, or when any `deallocations[i].amount <= 0n` (raised by `encodeForceDeallocateCall`<!-- -->).

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The VaultV2 address.

- `params.args.deallocations`<!-- -->: The deallocations to perform before withdrawing. Must be non-empty.

- `params.args.withdraw.amount`<!-- -->: Amount of underlying assets to withdraw after the deallocations complete.

- `params.args.withdraw.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the withdrawn assets.

- `params.args.onBehalf`<!-- -->: Address whose shares are burned and from which the deallocation penalty is taken.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the multicall transaction.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV2ForceWithdraw } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV2ForceWithdraw({
  vault: { address: vaultAddress },
  args: {
    deallocations: [{ adapter, marketParams, amount: 500_000n }],
    withdraw: { amount: 500_000n, recipient },
    onBehalf,
  },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2ForceWithdrawAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2inkindredeem"></a>

## vaultV2InKindRedeem() function

Prepares a Vault V2 in-kind redemption into idle assets and Morpho Blue supply positions.

`amount` includes the Vault V2 force-deallocation penalty. Without a signature this embeds the empty-permit sentinel and requires a sufficient share approval to VaultExitBundlesV1.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV2InKindRedeem: (params: VaultV2InKindRedeemParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2InKindRedeemAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV2InKindRedeemParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2inkindredeemparams)


</td><td>

In-kind redemption parameters.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV2InKindRedeemAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2inkindredeemaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2InKindRedeemAction>>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed action discriminator.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `amount` or `deadline` is not positive.

`UnsupportedChainIdError` when no address registry exists for the target chain.

`UnknownAddressError` when VaultExitBundlesV1 is not registered on the target chain.

`VaultExitBundlesV1PermitMismatchError` when the requirement has the wrong permit kind, asset, or signature encoding.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain containing the target Vault V2 and VaultExitBundlesV1.

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: Target Vault V2 address.

- `params.args.adapter`<!-- -->: Vault's sole MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2.

- `params.args.amount`<!-- -->: Penalty-inclusive, asset-denominated amount to exit.

- `params.args.marketParamsList`<!-- -->: Ordered markets consumed greedily after idle assets. May be empty when the vault's idle balance covers `amount`<!-- -->.

- `params.args.userAddress`<!-- -->: Expected transaction sender, recorded in action metadata only. VaultExitBundlesV1 burns `msg.sender`<!-- -->'s vault shares, so the submitting account must equal this address.

- `params.args.deadline`<!-- -->: Permit and bundle deadline.

- `params.args.requirementSignature`<!-- -->: Optional bounded Vault V2 shares permit.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV2InKindRedeem } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV2InKindRedeem({
  vault: { chainId: 1, address: vault },
  args: { adapter, amount: 1_000_000n, marketParamsList, userAddress, deadline },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2InKindRedeemAction>>
```

<a name="morpho-sdk.vaultv2redeem"></a>

## vaultV2Redeem() function

Prepares a redeem transaction for a VaultV2 contract.

Direct vault call — not routed through the bundler. Redeem has no inflation-attack surface, so skipping the bundler avoids an unnecessary approval and keeps the UX clean.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vaultV2Redeem: (params: VaultV2RedeemParams) => Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2RedeemAction>>
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

Description


</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

params


</td><td>

[VaultV2RedeemParams](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2redeemparams)


</td><td>


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Readonly&lt;[Transaction](#morpho-sdk.transaction)<!-- -->&lt;[VaultV2RedeemAction](#morpho-sdk.vaultv2redeemaction)<!-- -->&gt;&gt;

A deep-frozen `Transaction<VaultV2RedeemAction>` with `to`<!-- -->, `value`<!-- -->, `data`<!-- -->, and the typed `action` discriminator the simulation layer consumes.

## Exceptions

`NonPositiveInputError` when `shares <= 0n`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.vault.address`<!-- -->: The VaultV2 address.

- `params.args.shares`<!-- -->: Amount of vault shares to redeem.

- `params.args.recipient`<!-- -->: Address that receives the redeemed assets.

- `params.args.onBehalf`<!-- -->: Address whose shares are burned.

- `params.metadata`<!-- -->: Optional analytics metadata attached to the transaction.

## Example


```ts
import { vaultV2Redeem } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = vaultV2Redeem({
  vault: { address: vaultAddress },
  args: { shares: 1_000_000n, recipient, onBehalf },
});
// tx satisfies Readonly<Transaction<VaultV2RedeemAction>>
```
